subject: Startups
title: The AARRR Framework
description: A 60-second lesson on The AARRR Framework.

hook.text: Dave McClure gave growth a pirate name: AARRR. Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Referral, Revenue.

buildup.text: Most startups only track sign-ups. AARRR forces you to measure the full journey from first click to paying customer.

discovery.text: The framework reveals where users drop off. Fix the weakest stage first for the biggest impact on growth.

twist.text: Many startups discover their real problem isn't acquisition but activation. Users sign up but never engage.

climax.text: Twitter found that users who followed 30 people stuck around. So they redesigned onboarding to push follows early.

punchline.text: You can't fix growth if you don't know where it breaks.

quiz.question: What do the five letters in AARRR stand for?
